_comment: Input parameters that OpenMS 3.6 can read from a Parquet *directory bundle* (D30, stage 8c). Each entry gets a <conditional name="input_kind">: the default case keeps the single-file <param> as it is, the `bundle` case adds a list collection of `parquet` datasets that the command reassembles into <dir>/in.<kind>. The kinds are the ones the CTDs declare for the parameter (aux/upgrade/ctd-snapshots/3.6, supported_formats containing '*.idparquet' etc.), restricted to what the tool's reader can actually load.

_kinds.idparquet: IdXML bundle: psms, proteins, protein_groups, search_params (4 tables)
_kinds.featureparquet: FeatureMap bundle: features, psms, proteins, protein_groups, search_params (5 tables)
_kinds.consensusparquet: ConsensusMap bundle: consensus_features, psms, proteins, protein_groups, search_params (5 tables)

_scope._comment: stage 8c-i = tools whose *output* is not a bundle: a bundle can come in and a plain file goes out. A tool that mirrors its input (PeptideIndexer: idparquet in -> idparquet out) additionally needs the output collection to depend on the input case, and a tool whose parameter is an ITEMLIST needs a list-of-bundles collection; both are stage 8c-ii. Consumers still open (all ITEMLIST or mirror-only): FeatureFinderIdentification (id, candidates_in), FeatureLinkerLabeled, FeatureLinkerUnlabeled/-KD/-QT, IDConflictResolver, IDFilter, IDMerger, IDScoreSwitcher, IsobaricWorkflow, MS1LabeledWorkflow, MapAlignerIdentification, MapRTTransformer, PeptideIndexer, PercolatorAdapter, ProteomicsLFQ.
